fact: On 15 May 2024 the Ministry of Budget contracted IKA Conseil to build SAFIG 2, an integrated tax management system with a taxpayer portal for e-filing and e-payment, with mobile money payment planned in later versions; eTax has been operational since end 2020.
title: Termes de référence : Assistance en maitrise d’ouvrage pour le déploiement de SAFIG 2
